description: This file implements a class for testing voice wake word detection functionality in a macOS application, including speech recognition, audio input handling, and debug logging.

classes.name: VoiceWakeTester
classes.description: A class responsible for performing voice wake word detection testing, managing speech recognition sessions, and handling audio input.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and begins a voice recognition session with specified triggers and localization, reporting state updates via a callback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the current voice recognition session.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Ends recognition gracefully after a timeout, finalizing the session.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Processes recognition results, handles detection logic, and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: maybeLogDebug
methods.description: Logs debugging information related to the recognition process.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures the audio session based on preferred microphone ID.

methods.name: logInputSelection
methods.description: Logs the selected audio input device.

methods.name: ensurePermissions
methods.description: Checks and requests necessary permissions for speech recognition and microphone access.

methods.name: holdUntilSilence
methods.description: Holds recognition until silence is detected or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: scheduleSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check to detect silence after speech input.
